summary.labelledBy: deepseek-v4-flash for all 8,617 documents, except the 615 that ship as .eml, where the fine-tuned model is measurably more accurate (87.5% vs 78.4% correct on that subset) and its label is used instead
summary.note: kind is DeepSeek's label for every document. modelPrediction is the fine-tuned Legal-BERT's independent opinion, kept for comparison and used only to flag disagreements for review - except on .eml documents, where it supplies `kind` outright. `deepseekLabel` always records what DeepSeek said, so nothing is lost.
